column2: AMBIENCE - highest priority, and REOPENED (see the rewritten 'Ambient background' entry in DESIGN.md §5). Founder asked where this is; it was parked in error. OPEN design-refs/strips/Claryo_Ambiance_and_Scroll_Functionality_3.png and Claryo_Ambient_Hero_Page.png, both 10/10. Build BOTH halves. HALF ONE, the field: large soft bright purple blooms on PURE BLACK, continuously moving of their own accord, unbounded with no visible edge where the field starts or stops (that boundary is the only reason Slingshot scores 8 rather than 10). It must be obvious, not subtle - two previous attempts were rejected as invisible. tests/gimmicks.spec.ts already has 'ambient field moves on its own, with no cursor input' and 'ambient field is visible, not imperceptible' red and waiting; mount with data-testid="ambient-field". HALF TWO, the custom objects, which have never been built at all: a white technical line-work object over the field - in the reference a facility wireframe - that AUGMENTS as the visitor scrolls each step. Ours should be the venue/floor geometry Constantine actually measures. Product/atmosphere register only, never behind the technical register; hero demo stays the brightest thing; static under prefers-reduced-motion.

SCROLL FADES - refine what is already merged; do not start over. Founder verdict on the current behaviour: "we are seeing a fade in but the details still come up from the bottom". OPEN design-refs/strips/Claryo_Scroll_Functionality.png, Claryo_Scroll_Functionality_2.png and Claryo_Ambiance_and_Scroll_Functionality_3.png (all 10/10). In the reference a scroll causes the OUTGOING content to fade OUT and the incoming to fade IN, so that the new content is the only thing, or almost the only thing, on the page. That is a cross-fade between states, not an upward entrance animation. Remove the translate-from-below motion. Each scroll step should leave one piece of content holding the screen. Preserve what already passes: tests/reveal.spec.ts requires a reveal to end fully readable, and grounds must still change with no visible dividing line.

YOUR STACK - currently 5/10 per founder; rebuild against design-refs/strips/Pocket_Product.png, which is 10/10 and is a VIDEO reference so watch the dashes travel between frames. The construction: our product object at the centre, four surrounding capability cards, and curved connectors between them that ANIMATE - flowing dashes moving along the path. Use the BLUE from our palette tokens for the connectors, per founder instruction. Each card carries real infrastructure icons: AWS, Databricks, and the other systems a customer already runs. HONESTY CONSTRAINT, non-negotiable under §9: these are systems Constantine can EXPORT TO or INGEST FROM, and the framing must say so - 'works with your existing stack' - never a partnership, never a certification, never an endorsement, no 'trusted by'. Naming a system you can integrate with is a capability claim and is fine; implying a relationship is not. Connector motion freezes under prefers-reduced-motion.

SELECTOR - refine the merged entry view; do not rebuild it. Three specific founder notes against design-refs/strips/Clary_Selector.png (10/10): (a) the small tiles/markers beside 'Museums & Galleries' and 'Gyms' are currently identical, and must visually differentiate the two verticals; (b) the reference uses a WHITE ground for the entry screen and ours is black - switch to the light ground, which also makes the fade into the dark hero a stronger transition; (c) mirror the reference more closely in general - the pill geometry, the weight and position of the question, the drift path to the top right. Keep the required testids (vertical-selector, select-museums, select-gyms) and keep hero-tab-museums / hero-tab-gyms working.

CARD ELEVATION AND HOVER - never built, and it is a 10/10 reference nobody was ever tasked with. OPEN design-refs/strips/Claryo_Interactive_functionality.png. On hover, a card RAISES and its detail appears. Apply this to the repeated card modules across the site: use cases, value, the how-it-works steps, the stack capability cards. It must work on touch as a tap-to-expand, must not fight the hero demos' own hover behaviour (§3 - they are protected and take priority), and must be inert under prefers-reduced-motion. Also apply the Pocket card aesthetic from design-refs/Pocket-Feature-Cards-1.png and -2.png to the FAQ, which the founder scores 2/10 for engagement and calls weak relative to the rest of the page.

NO SECTION IS A WALL OF TEXT - founder found privacy (and others) showing nothing but block text, which is exactly the Slingshot 2/10 anti-reference: design-refs/strips/Slingshot_Scroll.png. tests/reveal.spec.ts now fails any section over 300 characters with no visual; four sections currently fail - problem, value, privacy and use cases. Give each one something to look at, sized so the section still composes in one viewport. For PRIVACY the founder asked specifically for people: anonymised figures with blurred or unresolved faces that SHOW the no-tracking claim rather than asserting it in prose. Reuse the volumetric GhostFigure work already in the Outputs section rather than inventing a second idiom. §5's rule is absolute - no facial detail may resolve, ever.
